headline: SSX goes online: friends race the mountain together
lede: A reusable multiplayer-room layer on the relay now lets up to four friends host a code, fill the field with CPUs, start on one seed, and watch each other as live ghosts — ranked on a shared podium with no lockstep.

notes.text: #856 SSX ONLINE shipped: ?net=host opens a 4-letter room, friends join by code, CPU riders fill the field, the host starts everyone on one seed.
No lockstep (riders don't collide): each racer races locally and sees the others as live ghosts; per-heat finish times flow to every box so the friends' podium is identical everywhere.
The relay generalised from 2P to 4P (explicit cap + roster broadcast) and src/utils/room.js is now a reusable room client the next multiplayer title can adopt verbatim.
Real internet play needs the updated relay worker redeployed on Cloudflare; until then online pairs against the identical local test relay. Single-player unchanged (ssxcheck 213/213).

look.text: Host a race: SSX with ?net=host, share the code
